events.name: Bonfire and Fireworks – Shropshire Hills Discovery Centre
events.description: Gates open at 5pm, the bonfire is lit at 7pm and fireworks follow at 7.30pm. Advance tickets shown are £6.30 adult and £4.50 child, with under-5s free; on-the-gate prices are £7 adult and £5 child, with under-5s free. Gates close at 7.15pm with no entry after that time. Dogs and sparklers are not allowed.
events.parking_transport: Parking is off site in designated car parks around the town, a short walk from the centre.

events.name: Cookery Workshop – Mediterranean chicken or vegan chickpea tray bake
events.description: Free cookery workshop. Ingredients and equipment are provided, with a recipe card to take away and time to enjoy the cooked lunch together. Booking is essential.
events.age_guidance: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Moon & Magic Market
events.description: Alternative makers market celebrating creativity, community and a little touch of magic, with makers, artists, readers, practitioners and independent businesses.

events.name: Wildlings Outdoor Toddler Group
events.description: Outdoor fun and wild play for young children with Shropshire Wildlife Trust, including exploring, den building, minibeast hunting and mud play. Standard price £6.50 per child; additional sibling £3.50; babies in arms can attend free when accompanying an older sibling.
events.accessibility: Accessible toilet and baby-changing facilities are listed. Assistance dogs only.
events.age_guidance: 0–5; older siblings allowed with suggested age cap 7

events.name: Family Tree Planting Day – Hampton Loade – 28 October
events.venue: Hampton Loade car park, Dudmaston Estate
events.description: Free, hands-on family tree planting day at Hampton Loade on the Dudmaston Estate. Friendly demonstrations are provided before families and community members plant young trees. Tree whips, guards and planting materials are supplied. Booking is essential.
events.accessibility: National Trust advises a short walk from the meeting point to the planting site and says access requirements can be discussed with the venue. Portable toilet available.
events.age_guidance: Families; no age limit stated by organiser

events.name: Saturday Morning Cinema: Matilda
events.description: Wellington Orbit's low-cost Saturday Morning Cinema screening of Matilda (PG). The venue's Saturday programme offers family-friendly films for £1.50 per ticket. Runtime is 98 minutes; the organiser does not publish an end time.
